grade: Source-supported control-flow counterexample; not a newly executed failure witness. Original software-positive cutoff is unchanged.
precondition: The supplied development adapter creates a business worker only from an application StartupEvent observer and invokes its long-lived delegate once. After that delegate completes, the development host remains alive for reload.
mechanism: The official compatible instrumentation branch avoids the runtime restart callback and consequently does not emit a fresh application startup lifecycle. Redefining method bodies therefore does not, by itself, resurrect an already-completed delegate.
operator_boundary: Do not blindly apply a full-restart stop-worker-then-scan procedure to same-delegate body updates. Preserve a healthy worker at an enforced safe action boundary when verifying in-place calls; an ended delegate needs a separately proved legitimate resume or a full lifecycle. This is conditional on that adapter design, not a claim about every framework application.
operations: No new model request, JVM, host/config operation, endpoint or test. Source-only addition; no current business adoption or speed claim.
